scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun run gen:wasm && bun build index.ts session.ts --target node --packages external --splitting --outdir dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.release: bun run build && bun pm pack --destination release
scripts.check:release: bun run build && sh -c 'd=$(mktemp -d) && bun pm pack --destination "$d" >/dev/null && f=$(basename "$d"/*.tgz) && cmp -s "$d/$f" "release/$f"; r=$?; rm -rf "$d"; [ $r = 0 ] || { echo "release/$f не совпадает с исходниками — bun run release и закоммить архив" >&2; exit 1; }'
scripts.check:lazy: sh -c 'if grep -l @mtcute dist/index*.js; then echo "лёгкий вход @mpu/telegram тянет @mtcute — клиент MTProto только за ./session" >&2; exit 1; fi'
scripts.check:binary: sh -c 'd=$(mktemp -d) && bun build --compile scripts/crypto-probe.ts --outfile "$d/probe" >/dev/null && (cd "$d" && ./probe); r=$?; rm -rf "$d"; exit $r'
scripts.gate: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test:bun && bun run test:node && bun run test:deno && bun run check:release && bun run check:lazy && bun run check:binary
